name: $loc:activity.expand-export
note: The most expensive thing in the game and the longest. Everything upstream is capped by it. RATE, not price (finding 289): $22.5M and 4.5 turns per kilometre, derived from the measured $45M/9t over the composed 2 km trunk the price was authored against - so a hand-built field reproduces its economy exactly, and a generated route prices its own kilometres.
